objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction, etc.) that passes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning, and archiving lifecycle stages.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g., policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchy level in the document pyramid (Level 1–4).

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation prefix used in the document name (e.g., RL).

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Cross-client, 4-digit sequential number per document type.

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: User-defined title of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g., Editing, Released, Out of Force).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the document.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Calculated expiry date (Valid From + period of extended validity).

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Time span for which the document remains valid before re-check (default 3 years).

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Retention period after invalidation before physical deletion (default 10 years).

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original file format of the document content (e.g., Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other master data, IT applications, or related documents maintained in properties.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or areas of validity associated with the document.

attributes.name: client_visibility
attributes.description: Specification of which clients in a multi-client system can see the document.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document linked to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and is released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the attachment.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the attachment.

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: A supplementary, non-controlled document added to a main document that is not subject to the release cycle and can be published directly.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal request created by an author to propose amendments to an existing released document without directly affecting its content or version history.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the change proposal (e.g., created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request triggered 30 days before document validity expiry, requiring workflow-supported processing to extend or end document validity.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request created to invalidate a released document and archive it, withdrawing it from circulation.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request created to reactivate a previously invalidated (archived) document, restoring its validity.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who interacts with the system in one or more roles (author, co-author, reviewer, releaser, translator, reader, initiator).

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System/license role assigned to the user (Reader, Author, Translator, etc.).

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used to assign read or other authorizations collectively to documents and distribution lists.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process instance that orchestrates approval steps (Creator, Review, Release) with tasks assigned to participants.

attributes.name: workflow_type
attributes.description: Type of workflow (e.g., release with signature, validity extension, override, reactivation, acknowledgement, translation release).

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A digital signature applied by a workflow participant to confirm completion of a workflow step.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A configurable list of user groups and persons assigned to a document for notification or acknowledgement upon release.

attributes.name: distribution_type
attributes.description: Type of distribution: by e-mail or for acknowledgement.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type that can be selected when creating new document objects.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: A recorded confirmation by a reader that they have taken note of a released document version, tracked via workflow.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Whether the acknowledgement has been confirmed or is still pending.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A role-specific view in the system that displays relevant documents, tasks, and evaluation information to users.

attributes.name: dashboard_type
attributes.description: Type of dashboard (e.g., Reader Document List, Author).

objs.name: report
objs.description: An evaluation or search function providing filtered results about documents and their statuses based on selection parameters.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Type of report (e.g., Status report, Search for documents, Acknowledgement report).

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document object is created in the system by attaching a new information object and selecting the corresponding document type and optional template.

attributes.name: document_type_selected
attributes.description: The document type chosen during creation.

attributes.name: template_selected
attributes.description: The template chosen during creation, if any.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is modified using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are maintained or changed via the properties editing dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: The system automatically converts the saved document to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The approval workflow (Creator–Review–Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first workflow step (Creator step) using an electronic signature.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document for technical and/or formal correctness as part of the release workflow.

attributes.name: review_type
attributes.description: Technical review or formal review.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves the document for publication in the release workflow step, applying an electronic signature.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, causing cancellation for all subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created when content, attributes, or attachments are changed.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A new controlled attachment is created and linked to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_information
evts.description: A non-controlled supplementary document is added to a main document without affecting its version.

evts.name: delete_additional_information
evts.description: An additional information item is removed from a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing released document.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, triggering creation of a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the completion of editing for an assigned change proposal.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a validity extension request 30 days before a document's Valid Until date.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: A releaser (or author/reviewer/releaser) confirms extended validity of a document, updating the Valid Until date.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document and start the override workflow.

evts.name: override_document
evts.description: The document is declared out of force, its status is set to Out of Force, and all rights except archive group are revoked.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A member of the Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate an archived document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: An archived document is reactivated, creating a new version with restored metadata, authorizations, and attachments.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or individual persons for a specific document.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: User groups or persons are added to or removed from a document's distribution list for email or acknowledgement distribution.

evts.name: distribute_by_email
evts.description: Users on the distribution list are notified by email upon release of a new document version.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users on the acknowledgement distribution list are requested by email to confirm they have read the released document.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A reader confirms acknowledgement of a document via a workflow-supported task without signature.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A translator creates a language-dependent version of a released document's content.

attributes.name: target_language
attributes.description: The language into which the document is translated.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated version of a document is checked and released through a workflow, making it visible in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system sends an email to inform users about workflow tasks, status changes, or distribution events.

attributes.name: notification_type
attributes.description: Type of notification (e.g., workflow task, release info, acknowledgement request, validity extension info).

evts.name: generate_report
evts.description: A user generates an evaluation report or search based on selected parameters and criteria.

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: The specific report being generated (e.g., Status report, Acknowledgement report).
